title: Which Stranger Things character are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Stranger Things quiz: answer 12 questions to find out whether you are Eleven, Mike, Dustin, Lucas, Will, Max, Steve or Hopper. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
h1: Which Stranger Things character are you?
lede: Would you face the Upside Down head-on, crack the code or keep everyone safe? Answer 12 questions about friendship, danger and Hawkins life to see which character you are.
about: Stranger Things, the Netflix series created by the Duffer Brothers, follows a group of friends in the small town of Hawkins, Indiana, in the 1980s as they face a secret laboratory and a dark parallel world, the Upside Down. This quiz matches you with eight of its characters: Eleven, Mike, Dustin, Lucas, Will, Max, Steve and Hopper.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Netflix or the show's creators; the names and characters belong to their owners.

faq.a: Eleven, Mike Wheeler, Dustin Henderson, Lucas Sinclair, Will Byers, Max Mayfield, Steve Harrington and Jim Hopper.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every character appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Why isn't my favorite character here?
faq.a: Eight results keep the quiz short and fair. Nancy, Jonathan, Joyce, Robin, Eddie and others may join in a later update.
Only light ones about the characters' personalities and the show's setting; no major plot twists.

Grab your skateboard and go see for yourself

Quietly draw what you saw so you won't forget

The one with the car, the bat and the good hair

options: Fix your hair and help someone else instead

eleven.name: Eleven
eleven.body: You are brave, loyal and stronger than you look. You may not always find the right words, but you show up for the people you love, whatever it takes. Let others protect you sometimes.

mike.name: Mike Wheeler
mike.body: You are a natural leader with a big heart and bigger plans. You never give up on a friend and you believe in people when others don't. Watch your temper when you're worried.

dustin.name: Dustin Henderson
dustin.body: You are curious, funny and endlessly inventive. You make friends anywhere, fix problems with gadgets and know a lot of facts. Your optimism keeps the group going.

lucas.name: Lucas Sinclair
lucas.body: You are practical, brave and fiercely loyal. You say what others are afraid to say and you have a good aim with a slingshot and an argument. You keep your friends grounded.

will.name: Will Byers
will.body: You are gentle, creative and more resilient than anyone knows. You feel things deeply and express them through art. You've survived more than most, and kindness is still your first instinct.

max.name: Max Mayfield
max.body: You are tough, independent and quick on a skateboard. You keep people at arm's length until they earn your trust, then you'd fight for them. It's okay to let people see when you're hurting.

steve.name: Steve Harrington
steve.body: You may have started out as the cool kid, but you've grown into everyone's protector. You're brave, funny and great with younger kids. Your hair is a bonus.

hopper.name: Jim Hopper
hopper.body: You are gruff, protective and much softer than you let on. You'd do anything for the people you love, even if you can't always say it. Let your guard down once in a while.
